description: The player's eyes inside a still sulfur cube, a husk before it: the cube is picked and attacked; with a block in its body slot it isn't from inside (the husk is) and is from outside; emptied, it is again.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
